_comment: delta_radar config — all thresholds externalized, house style per space_radar

m1_revenue_acceleration._basis: 2026-05 YoY +43.7%; we monitor the 2nd derivative, not the level

m2_bullwhip_health._basis: Q1-2026 baseline: FCF/NI = 88.4/205.5 = 0.43; gate: Q2 must recover toward 0.6

m3_thai_shadow._basis: DELTA.BK Q1-2026 rev +56.2% YoY, GM 31.7%; sub reports ~2 days ahead of parent

m4_customs_flow._basis: US monthly imports of static converters (HS 8504.40) from TH+TW = physical AI-power flow proxy; data lags ~6 weeks

capex_cut.query: hyperscaler capex (cut OR reduce OR pause OR slowdown)

vr300_delay.query: Nvidia (VR300 OR Kyber OR Rubin Ultra) (delay OR pushed OR postponed)

debt_financed_capex.query: AI data center capex debt (bond OR borrowing OR negative free cash flow)

m5_narrative_triggers._calibration_note: 2026-06-11 first live run baseline: capex_cut=6 vr300_delay=10(w/ false pos) debt=18. Thresholds re-centered on this noise floor; switch to z-score vs state.json rolling baseline after ~5 runs.

m6_peer_divergence._basis: cohort relative momentum; we trade the divergence, not the level. TW mandatory monthly revenue = structural edge (peers report quarterly).

power._note: Lite-On(2301)/Acbel(6282) 反超 2308 = ASIC PSU 份額外溢的先行訊號

cooling._note: 雙鴻(3324)/AVC(3017) 斜率反超 = sidecar→L2L 遷移、2308 散熱故事打折

rack._note: 鴻海/廣達/緯穎 = 下游拉貨 proxy；整鏈同向 = buildout confirm，僅記錄不升級

m7_outcome_backfill._basis: T+5/10/20 forward returns of 2308 onto each state entry — makes the radar falsifiable (gate backtest). Runs after every scan; idempotent.
